hooks.command: [ -d wiki ] && [ -f wiki/hot.md ] && find wiki -name '*.md' ! -name 'hot.md' -newer wiki/hot.md -print -quit 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && echo 'WIKI_CHANGED: Wiki pages were modified this session. Please update wiki/hot.md with a brief summary of what changed (under 500 words). Use the hot cache format: Last Updated, Key Recent Facts, Recent Changes, Active Threads. Keep it factual. Overwrite the file completely. It is a cache, not a journal.' || true

hooks.prompt: Decide whether to suggest running the reflect skill before this session ends. Respond ONLY with JSON, no other text. Your default answer is {"ok": true} (silent approval). Answer {"ok": false, "reason": "Worth a /reflect: <what was learned, in a few words>"} ONLY if ALL of these hold: (1) wiki/LESSONS.md exists; (2) this was a substantive session about the user (their goals, decisions, corrections, preferences) with real dialogue — not just technical execution, explanations, or hook feedback; (3) there is a concrete new lesson or durable fact worth consolidating; (4) the transcript does not already contain a reflect suggestion — suggest at most once per session. When in doubt, {"ok": true}. The reason must only offer /reflect, never run it.
